serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: It went faster than I expected. Bot: Even small stalls like this one can be heavily automated these days. You: Isn’t it expensive to buy and operate all this machinery? Bot: It is, but in places like this, with high demand and high prices, it’s more profitable. Bot: Just like you weren’t thrilled about waiting for an hour in a queue, other potential clients are the same. Long service time will result in a low rating. You: It’s kinda sad to hear. I remember going to some rural festivals when I was younger and all the food there was handmade. Bot: I’m sure there are still places like that. Automatization of these food stalls like this isn’t cheap, after all. Bot: It’s our turn. What flavor will you order? You: Something basic. Strawberry and chocolate, I think. #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: I will get the same, we will match! You: You could do that, but how about you take something different? That way we could share with each other, right? Bot: That’s a good idea! Each of us could have a taste of two different crepes! It was unexpected of you to come up with something like that. #bot.Expression.veryHappy You: Hey! I also have some good ideas from time to time! Bot: You sure do giggles. That’s just plain rude… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Happy You: Anyway, what will you get? Bot: Mushroom and blue cheese crepe. You: W-What? Bot: It’s a savory crepe. You ordered a sweet one so I chose this. You: That’s pretty unorthodox. I’m surprised that it’s possible to order something like that in an amusement park. Bot: I’m sure you’re gonna like it.
